entry.description: Prefer Jakarta EE modules (`log4j-jakarta-web`, `log4j-jakarta-jms`, `log4j-jakarta-jpa`, `log4j-jakarta-smtp`) over their javax counterparts (`log4j-web`, `log4j-jms`, `log4j-jpa`, `log4j-smtp`) on Jakarta EE 9+ and Servlet 5.0+ runtimes. Do not deploy javax and Jakarta variants together.
